Question: Which of the following events occurs when insulin binds to its receptor ?:

Options:
opa. Increases the amount of phosphorylated threonine residues in the sub subunits of the receptor.
opb. Increases the amount of phosphorylated serine and threonine residues in the extracellular part of the receptor.
opc. The receptor catalyzes its own phosphorylation on tyrosine residues from its cytosolic part.
opd. The receptor is autophosphorylated in the extracellular region where its ɑ and β chains are contacted.
